status: New concrete P2 finding blocks treating the current collector as ready for the paid full-smoke retry until a narrow patch is independently verified. Existing path/gate/no-provider conclusions remain valid.
finding: Unbounded invalid-line metadata amplification bypasses derivative data cap
trigger: One allowed DSH zstd session containing 131072 non-JSON lines (b"x\n" * 131072). Input is 34 compressed bytes / 262144 decoded bytes, safely below both current limits.
impact: Per-invalid-line dicts accumulate in memory and diagnostics.json is written outside the data budget. A tiny corrupt/changed-format native trace can create an oversized artifact; multiple traces amplify further and can exhaust collector resources precisely on the failure path intended to preserve evidence.
boundedness_note: The original report accurately distinguished the 8 MiB data cap from the separate index, but did not establish a practical index bound. This reproducer is a concrete gap in the new bounded diagnostic requirement, not a new generic safety requirement.
minimal_fix_expectation: Keep complete invalid-line count and original full source hash; retain only a fixed maximum number of invalid-line samples with explicit omitted count/status.
Bound total index metadata/serialized size (or a demonstrably bounded structure) without copying malformed payloads or relabeling a partial parse as complete.
Keep source/candidate goal, self-edit strictness, original budget and unrelated runtime unchanged; preserve this failing case as a regression.
validation_needed: Exact new small commit, focused malformed/oversized/partial diagnostic regression and existing smoke gate checks; no model/workflow dispatch required by reviewer.
